_readme: The one conversation in this game that hands something over, and the shape every
such conversation should copy: the gift sits on a CHOICE carrying `set_flag`, and
A node cannot do this. It has no condition and no memory of having been entered, so
a conversation looping back through it gives a second flask every pass. The pair
below is 'taken once, offered never again' - and it works on the FIRST pass too,
because the runner counts flags earned earlier in the same conversation, not just
the ones already written to the game state.
Both replies END the conversation rather than looping back to the greeting. A choice
line cannot be escaped with cancel - the whole point of a choice is that one is
picked - so a loop through a choice is a conversation with no way out of it.

greet.speaker: Hermit
greet.text: Nobody comes down here for the view.

ask.speaker: Hermit
ask.text: There is oil on the shelf. More than one person needs.

choices.text: Could I have some of that oil?

gave.speaker: Hermit
gave.text: Take a flask. Mind the wick - it catches faster than you expect.
